documents.title: NASA Planetary Systems data dictionary — source notes
documents.text:
The ps table can contain several published parameter sets for a planet. The pl_name field identifies the planet; default_flag identifies the archive-selected parameter set.
disc_year is the year of discovery. discoverymethod describes the first means of identification, while tran_flag records whether the planet transits.

documents.title: NASA Table Access Protocol guide — source notes
documents.text: NASA's TAP service provides ps data in CSV format. Its confirmed-planet counting example uses default_flag=1 to restrict the count to default solutions.

documents.title: NASA archive FAQ on transit membership — source notes
documents.text: A planet discovered by a different technique can subsequently be found to transit. The archive identifies known transiting planets with tran_flag=1.

experiment.title: Annual transit-related discoveries
experiment.goal: Compare counts of transit-related confirmed planet discoveries in 2022 and 2023.

documents.title: Walkthrough study design
documents.text: The comparison uses the discovery years 2022 and 2023. The unit of analysis is a confirmed planet. The requested outputs are the two counts and the later count minus the earlier count. The query, retrieval date and input CSV belong in the study record.
